title: Download all matching daily loading-list evidence summaries as Chinese PDF
description: Add separately labelled summary PDF download and POST export-summary-pdf to existing controller, rebuild fresh bounded authorized full-match Summary from same validated request independent of detail fields/current page. Narrow DynamicContainerStatsSummaryPdfExporter uses installed PDFsharp and current local SimHei resolver through direct call, no font/package/config/DI writes; allow existing detail PDF exporter only for smallest needed reuse of existing font/layout helper, preserving its page-only behavior. Fixed daily summary columns date,bucket/list/missing-number-list counts and signed recorded cartons/kg/m3, separate period totals, never customer/container detail or global distinct-customer totals. Chinese headings and mandatory date/filter/all-match coverage/scope/source cap/unit/grouping/unknown actual capacity/type/shipping context; stable daily order and repeated table headers. Paginate/wrap within margins using measured layout, repeat date identity on column splits if needed, no clipped numbers or concealed daily/period evidence. Empty evidence explicit, zero and negative distinct; unavailable Chinese font/render/layout failure rejects output. Existing detail PDF download stays current-page. Test generated PDF bytes/text/page structure where supported and layout/renderer inputs, not screenshot/browser-only claims. Development only, readonly increments in existing container-stats report architecture. Reuse current identity/container-stats menu and freshly resolved SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope on every preview/download; validated customer/raw-number/date filters intersect permission, never expand it. Only approved nondeleted ContainerLoadingList persisted header evidence, dates <=366 inclusive calendar days with whole end day via next-day exclusive overflow-safe boundary, stable Take(501) probe after all source predicates, reject >500 matching authorized headers. No client identity/scope/rows/totals or cached preview as authority. Recorded cartons/kg/m3 are signed list-header measures, not actual shipment, stock-out, physical container totals, revenue or known capacity/type; never infer utilization from 68m3 or scoped customer count. Never add unlike units or bucket customer counts into global unique-customer claims. Existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit, no business writes/audit entities. No new domain entities or persistence/schema/mapping changes required: current ContainerLoadingList already has all read fields. No migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, arbitrary/model SQL, real database execution, production deployment, irreversible data operations, credentials/secrets/.env/config/package/DI changes, XAUUSD/NEWAPP or unrelated refactors. Preserve uncommitted work. Focused in-memory service/controller/export and UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release restore/build/test; unavailable real database/browser validation is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Dedicated summary PDF endpoint rebuilds full-match evidence after fresh identity/menu/scope and request validation, independent of detail page/selection, and returns no file on revocation, overflow or rendering failure.
Chinese PDF preserves fixed daily/period summary semantics, signed separate units and mandatory full coverage/unknown-evidence context with readable repeated headers and explicit font/layout errors.

Existing UI retains request state and reports errors for separate summary PDF download; PDF/controller/UI tests cover multi-page dates, empty/signed evidence, missing-number counts and fresh scope/cap checks, and safe build/test passes.
